messages.author: Joanna Michelle E. Chua
messages.body:
Dear all,
I am having a problem installing amber 20 in Ubuntu thru "make install". This is the error script that appeared.
-- Fixing Miniconda script shebangs
CMake Error at /home/itsrdc/Downloads/amber20_src/cmake/FixCondaShebang/FixCondaShebang.cmake:26 (file):
file failed to open for reading (No such file or directory):
/home/itsrdc/Downloads/amber20//bin/amber.pip
When I checked the folder, amber.pip appeared in amber 20/bin subfolder.
Can someone help me with this? Thank you very much.
Best regards,
Joanna

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Dec 02, 2021, Joanna Michelle E. Chua wrote:
> file failed to open for reading (No such file or directory):
> /home/itsrdc/Downloads/amber20//bin/amber.pip
This message is innocuous, if annoying. I'm pretty sure nothing bad will
happen if you just ignore it. [Volunteers to get the fix, which is already
in the main development branch, pushed out as an update, are solicited.]
>
>When I checked the folder, amber.pip appeared in amber 20/bin subfolder.
It is probably a link to a non-existent file.
...dac
